headword: {弱肉強食|じゃくにくきょうしょく}
reading: じゃくにくきょうしょく
gloss: survival of the fittest; law of the jungle

definitions.gloss: survival of the fittest; law of the jungle
definitions.explanation: The principle that the strong prey upon the weak. Used to describe competitive situations in nature, business, or society where only the strongest survive.

examples.english: The natural world is ruled by survival of the fittest.

examples.english: The business world is also survival of the fittest.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{弱|じゃく} (weak) + {肉|にく} (meat/flesh) + {強|きょう} (strong) + {食|しょく} (eat)
"The strong eat the flesh of the weak"
Derived from classical Chinese, describing the natural order where stronger creatures prey on weaker ones.

USAGE:
Often used critically to describe ruthless competition in business, politics, or society. Can be neutral when describing nature, but often carries a negative connotation when applied to human society.
